title: Sr. Desktop Support Engineer
description:
Job description:

Job Description – IT Hardware & Network Support EngineerResponsibilities:

* Installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT hardware.
* Installation and configuration of networking equipment such as routers, switches, Wi-Fi devices, and LAN cabling.
* Diagnosing hardware and network issues and providing technical support.
* Preventive maintenance and regular health checks of systems and networks.
* Providing onsite and remote support to clients and internal teams.
* Maintaining service reports and technical documentation.

Skills Required:

* Knowledge of computer hardware and networking.
* Basic troubleshooting skills for Windows OS and network devices.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.

Qualification:

* Diploma / B.Tech / ITI in IT, Electronics, Networking, or related field.

Experience:

* Experienced candidates can apply.

Location:

* Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

**apply: manisha@vishaldigital.com**

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Pay: ₹28,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
